data.mu_q_definition: μ_q(n)=μ_q(n−1)+[n−1]_q μ_q(n−2) (symmetric bracket) — crossing q-Hermite / Rogers–Szegő moment; the q-deformation of I(n) with the clean depth-2 kernel R(q,x).
data.win_clean_kernel: μ_q satisfies the depth-2 q-telephone by construction (μ_q is DEFINED by it; the residual 0.0 is a definition sanity-check, not a discovered identity). The substantive contrast: the quantum-dim period Σ_λ dim_q has NO such low-order kernel (sibling probe sw_period_qholonomic_kernel_search.py) ⇒ μ_q is the deformation that carries the clean R(q,x) (prop:binding-genfun-qdifference), Σ dim_q is not.
data.win_bar_even: μ_q(n) q↔q⁻¹-invariant for n=2..7: True (palindromic; ties to BindingQHermiteOscillator #2800).
data.cost_divergence: μ_q < T_q for n≥4; ⁴He(n=4) a_D shift -0.324%, max divergence (n=8) 7.86%. Smaller period at higher body order — pushes against the collective under-binding (weights-gated, scope-(a)).
data.cost_mass_binding_decoupling: lw=(1/n)Σ dim_q feeds BOTH MBA step-9a (mass) AND step-9b (binding). Swapping binding→μ_q decouples them — breaks the shared-selection-rule unification; no mass-preserving swap without a new categorical interface (formalize-first: not to be guessed).
data.killswitch_neutral: The +5.87% magic-A ⁴He kill-switch is a separate mechanism (B=ρ_F·m_e·A·8G, 8G=Vol(Borromean)); μ_q's −0.32% a_D^(4) shift does not materially move it.
data.verdict: μ_q is coherent (clean kernel, bar-even, deuteron-exact). Trade-offs vs the quantum-dim selection rule: it decouples mass↔binding and runs smaller at higher body order (the high-isotope behaviour to watch).
